bullets.text: In Uthukottai, heavy rains submerged 400 acres of paddy crops due to highway work, and the office should monitor relief for affected farmers.
Near Sholavaram in Thiruvallur, two lorry drivers were detained for murdering and burying a colleague, and the office should watch police updates.
On Velachery Main Road, water-filled potholes threaten motorists, and the office should coordinate with local authorities to fix the road immediately.
In Poonamallee, passengers protested after waiting two hours for a government bus, and the office should request transport officials to improve bus frequency.
In Thiruvallur, three members of the same family passed away consecutively, and the office should watch for official reports and offer support.
Tamil Nadu fixed security flaws in 10 government PHP websites with two more under repair, and the office should watch the IT secretary's progress.

takeaways: Heavy rains in Ponthavakkam and surrounding areas near Uthukottai submerged 400 acres of paddy crops.
District administration officials must assess the agricultural damage and disburse relief to affected farmers.

Work is ongoing to secure remaining platforms ensuring robust digital governance infrastructure.
